description: Paid ($0.002/call): Current weather conditions for any location on Earth: temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind speed/direction/gusts, precipitation, cloud cover, pressure, and human-readable condition. Global coverage by coordinates or place name; no account needed. Cached for up to 5 minutes. ?lat=48.86&lon=2.35 or ?place=Paris. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0).

lat.description: Latitude, -90 to 90 (with lon; wins over place)

place.description: A city, town or region name instead of lat/lon, for example "Paris" or "Austin, TX" (not a street address); the answer echoes the place it resolved to

name: weather.current

place.description: Present when the location was given by name

title: Current weather (global)
